<external_ide_context># Context from my IDE setup:

## Open tabs:
- CHALLENGE.md: CHALLENGE.md
- requirements.md: docs/requirements.md
- README.md: README.md
</external_ide_context>
My local fork missing tools folder, please pull fresh contents from main
I’ll check the remote and local changes, then restore the `tools` folder from `main`.

input.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"pwd && rg --files -g AGENTS.md -g '!node_modules' -g '!vendor' . /home/user 2>/dev/null | head -60","max_output_tokens":2000}));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short && git remote -v && git branch --show-current && entire agent-help","max_output_tokens":4000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git pull --ff-only origin main","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I pull the latest main branch? The sandbox blocks Git from updating .git/FETCH_HEAD.","prefix_rule":["git","pull"],"max_output_tokens":3000,"yield_time_ms":10000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git ls-tree --name-only HEAD && git log -1 --oneline && rg -n 'tools|github.com|upstream' README.md CHALLENGE.md docs/requirements.md .git/config","max_output_tokens":4000}));

content.text: Your fork’s `main` is already up to date, but it has no `tools` folder. I’ll check the parent repository for the missing contents.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/ra1234-dev/ai-full-stack-it-access-requests","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I look up this fork’s parent repository on GitHub to locate the missing tools folder? Network access is restricted in the sandbox.","prefix_rule":["curl","-fsSL"],"max_output_tokens":6000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git fetch https://github.com/GitRollTraining/ai-full-stack-it-access-requests.git main","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I fetch the parent repository’s main branch? Git needs network access and permission to update .git.","prefix_rule":["git","fetch"],"max_output_tokens":2000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git log --oneline HEAD..FETCH_HEAD && git diff --stat HEAD FETCH_HEAD && git ls-tree --name-only FETCH_HEAD && git merge-base HEAD FETCH_HEAD","max_output_tokens":2500}));

content.text: The parent repository’s `main` has the missing `tools` folder, plus updated docs and starter tests. I’ll merge those changes into your local `main`; your existing Entire setup will be preserved.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git merge --no-edit FETCH_HEAD","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I merge the fetched upstream main into local main to bring in the missing tools and latest contents? The sandbox makes .git read-only.","prefix_rule":["git","merge"],"max_output_tokens":3000}));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short && cat README.md && cat .agents/skills/plan-from-spec/SKILL.md && git diff --cc README.md","max_output_tokens":4000}));

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/user/ai-full-stack-it-access-requests/README.md
@@
-<<<<<<< HEAD
 #test comment from Ram
 
 <!-- test comment -->
-=======
 
 In class, start with `docs/00-prerequisites.md` and follow the files in `docs/` in order.
->>>>>>> aea191e6dee4ee3cf7f9e648702e2a8574e0e071
*** End Patch"));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --check && rg --files tools tests","max_output_tokens":1500}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git add README.md && git commit --no-edit && git status --short && git log -1 --oneline && git diff HEAD aea191e -- tools docs tests","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I complete the upstream merge after preserving both your README comments and the new upstream instructions? Git needs write access to .git.","max_output_tokens":2500}));

content.text:
Merged upstream `main` into your local `main`. The `tools` folder, updated docs, and starter tests are now present.

Preserved your README comments and Entire setup. Working tree is clean. Changes are local; nothing was pushed.
